ud3.8:6.1: patirūpaṁ → paṭirūpaṁ (sya-all, pts) | evarūpiṁ → evarūpaṁ (sya-all) | saddhā → saddhāya (pts) | katheyyātha → katheyyātha sannisinnānaṁ (pts) | saddhā → saddhāyātipi …pe… (sya-all note)
